title: Distinguish existing and proposed data in the ERD
statement: As an Architect or Developer, I can easily distinguish existing data entities and relationships from proposed additions or changes in the ERD so I can understand the intended model without mistaking it for implemented reality.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The ERD diagram, entity directory, details, and query results expose the same explicit proposal/implementation distinctions for entities and relationships.
A proposed entity or relationship remains visible and usable in the design even before implementation code is available.
Missing, stale, or unresolved code references are reported separately from proposal/implementation status and comparison-relative newness.
Recording implementation with supporting code evidence retains the previous proposal and permits comparison with the committed design; it does not itself imply verification or approval.
